drafter.private_reasoning: The draft leaves the settlement amount and payment timing unresolved. The release should take effect only upon receipt of payment and should be limited to the claims being settled. A confidentiality clause needs practical exceptions. Do not disclose the client's confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please see proposed revisions to clarify payment, the scope and effective date of the release, and routine confidentiality exceptions. The settlement amount and payment deadline remain for the parties to agree.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount of [AMOUNT] by [DATE], using payment instructions provided by Plaintiff in writing.
edits.name: Payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the matters asserted in this dispute through the date of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Release scope

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice, carry out or enforce this Agreement, or make disclosures to insurers or auditors, provided that recipients are informed of the confidential nature of the terms where practicable.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We are prepared to discuss the release and confidentiality provisions. The proposed release is limited to claims arising from the matters asserted in this dispute through the date of the Agreement, with enforcement rights preserved. We are not proposing any further exclusions within that scope, subject to client confirmation. We agree that the settlement amount and payment deadline remain open and that no agreement is reached unless those terms are agreed in writing.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount of [AMOUNT] by [DATE], using payment instructions provided by Plaintiff in writing. 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the matters asserted in this dispute through the date of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice, carry out or enforce this Agreement, or make disclosures to insurers or auditors, provided that recipients are informed of the confidential nature of the terms where practicable. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
